xy1-14.name: Spiky Shield
xy1-14.text: If this Pokemon is your Active Pokemon and is damaged by an opponent's attack, even if this Pokemon is Knocked Out, put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokemon.
xy1-14.displayText: Si este Pokemon es tu Pokemon Activo y recibe dano de un ataque de tu rival, incluso si este Pokemon queda Fuera de Combate, pon 3 contadores de dano en el Pokemon Atacante.

xy1-26.name: Mystical Fire
xy1-26.text: Once during your turn, before your attack, you may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
xy1-26.displayText: Una vez durante tu turno, antes de atacar, puedes robar cartas hasta tener 6 cartas en tu mano.

xy1-41.name: Water Shuriken
xy1-41.text: Once during your turn, before your attack, you may discard a Water Energy card from your hand. If you do, put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokemon.
xy1-41.displayText: Una vez durante tu turno, antes de atacar, puedes descartar 1 Energia Agua de tu mano. Si lo haces, pon 3 contadores de dano en 1 de los Pokemon de tu rival.

xy1-44.name: Destiny Burst
xy1-44.text: If this Pokemon is your Active Pokemon and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, put 5 damage counters on the Attacking Pokemon.
xy1-44.displayText: Si este Pokemon es tu Pokemon Activo y queda Fuera de Combate por el dano de un ataque de tu rival, lanza 1 moneda. Si sale cara, pon 5 contadores de dano en el Pokemon Atacante.

xy1-55.name: Forest's Curse
xy1-55.text: As long as this Pokemon is your Active Pokemon, your opponent can't play any Item cards from his or her hand.
xy1-55.displayText: Mientras este Pokemon sea tu Pokemon Activo, tu rival no puede jugar cartas de Objeto de su mano.

xy1-74.name: Upside-Down Evolution
xy1-74.text: If this Pokemon is Confused, put the top card of your deck onto it and evolve it. Shuffle your deck afterward.
xy1-74.displayText: Si este Pokemon esta Confundido, busca una carta de tu mazo que evolucione de el, ponla sobre este Pokemon y luego baraja tu mazo.

xy1-85.name: Stance Change
xy1-85.text: Once during your turn, before your attack, you may switch this Pokemon with an Aegislash in your hand.
xy1-85.displayText: Una vez durante tu turno, antes de atacar, puedes cambiar este Pokemon por otro Aegislash de tu mano.

xy1-86.name: Stance Change
xy1-86.text: Once during your turn, before your attack, you may switch this Pokemon with an Aegislash in your hand.
xy1-86.displayText: Una vez durante tu turno, antes de atacar, puedes cambiar este Pokemon por otro Aegislash de tu mano.

xy1-93.name: Fairy Transfer
xy1-93.text: As often as you like during your turn, before your attack, you may move a Fairy Energy from 1 of your Pokemon to another of your Pokemon.
xy1-93.displayText: Todas las veces que quieras durante tu turno, antes de atacar, puedes mover 1 Energia Hada de 1 de tus Pokemon a otro de tus Pokemon.

xy1-95.name: Sweet Veil
xy1-95.text: Each of your Pokemon that has any Fairy Energy attached to it can't be affected by any Special Conditions. Remove any Special Conditions already affecting those Pokemon.
xy1-95.displayText: Cada uno de tus Pokemon que tenga alguna Energia Hada unida no puede verse afectado por Condiciones Especiales. Quita las Condiciones Especiales que ya los afecten.

xy1-103.name: Drive Off
xy1-103.text: Once during your turn, before your attack, you may force your opponent to switch his or her Active Pokemon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokemon.
xy1-103.displayText: Una vez durante tu turno, antes de atacar, puedes hacer que tu rival cambie su Pokemon Activo por 1 de sus Pokemon en Banca.

xy1-114.name: Fur Coat
xy1-114.text: This Pokemon takes 20 less damage from attacks after applying Weakness and Resistance.
xy1-114.displayText: Este Pokemon recibe 20 puntos menos de dano por ataques despues de aplicar Debilidad y Resistencia.
